## One-time setup

1. Open **Configure Multiverse** and enter the season-specific Sleeper league ID.
2. Leave weekOverride at 0 for automatic weekly runs. Set it to 1–18 for historical tests.
3. The schedule runs Tuesdays at 9:00 AM in the workflow timezone. The workflow remains unpublished until you choose to publish it.

## How the multiverse works

Each team is replayed against every other score from the analyzed week. The workflow compares that all-play win rate with the real matchup result, ranks the resulting luck swing, then posts one aggregated three-embed webhook message. If the live week has no scoring yet, it safely checks the previous week; if neither has data, it sends nothing.
